address: Avenida de la Constitución 7, Talavera de la Reina, 45600, Spain
bio: Located in a central residential area, this family-run restaurant will pleasantly surprise guests thanks to the efforts of the Trujillo brothers (with David in charge of front of house, and Pedro in the kitchen) who showcase their creativity through dishes teeming with local flavour and tradition. The menu, which includes several dishes inspired by the world of hunting, begins with a selection of small bites and several dishes designed for sharing. Don't miss their creamy, award-winning Manchego cheesecake!...
